title: Equilibria in heterogeneous multi-strategy network games
abstract: arXiv:2607.10997v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this paper, we analyze a multi-strategy network game with three types of players, conformists, rebels, and stubborn agents. Conformists adopt the strategy that is most common among their neighbors, rebels adopt the least common, and stubborn agents adhere to a fixed strategy. We study the existence and structure of pure strategy Nash equilibrium (PNE). On arbitrary networks, we establish sufficient conditions for PNE existence, and prove that in a broad class of large random networks the probability of PNE existence tends to zero as the network size grows. For several specific network architectures, such as complete network, lines, rings, trees, and stars, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions or develop an algorithm for determining PNE existence and characterize the equilibrium strategy frequencies. translated_title: 异构多策略网络博弈中的均衡
translated_abstract: 本文分析了一个包含三类参与者的多策略网络博弈：从众者、叛逆者和顽固者。从众者采用其邻居中最常见的策略，叛逆者采用最不常见的策略，而顽固者则坚持某一固定策略。我们研究了纯策略纳什均衡（PNE）的存在性与结构。在任意网络上，我们建立了PNE存在的充分条件，并证明在一大类大型随机网络中，PNE存在的概率随网络规模增大而趋于零。对于若干特定的网络结构，如完全网络、线、环、树和星形网络，我们推导了PNE存在的充要条件或开发了判定PNE存在的算法，并刻画了均衡下的策略频率。总体而言，这些结果提供了一个统一的视角：当每个从众者拥有更多从众邻居时，PNE很可能存在。
tldr: 本文研究了包含从众者、叛逆者和顽固者三类玩家的异构多策略网络博弈，建立了纯策略纳什均衡存在的充分条件，证明大型随机网络中均衡存在概率趋于零，并为完全网络、线、环、树、星形等典型网络结构给出了充要条件或判定算法。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes heterogeneous multi-strategy network games with conformists, rebels, and stubborn agents, establishing sufficient conditions for pure-strategy Nash equilibrium existence on arbitrary networks, proving that the probability of equilibrium existence vanishes in large random networks, and deriving necessary-and-sufficient conditions or algorithms for specific network architectures such as complete networks, lines, rings, trees, and stars.
